Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
interface CheckPrime {
    void prime(int n);
}

public class MethodRef3 {
    MethodRef3(int n) {
        boolean isPrime = true;
        for (int i = 2; i <= (int) Math.sqrt(n); i++) {
            if (n % i == 0) {
                isPrime = false;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (isPrime)
            System.out.println("Prime");
        else
            System.out.println("Not Prime");
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        CheckPrime cp = MethodRef3::new;
        System.out.print("257 Prime or Not? : ");
        cp.prime(257);
    }
}
